services.desc: Explore technique-focused training in ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, lyrical, acro, theater dance, and more. For current class times, please check our schedule-hours are seasonal. Creative movement and foundational rhythm, coordination, and classroom skills-Preschool (ages 3-4) and Kinder (ages 5-6). Build alignment, strength, and artistry through classical technique, barre work, and center practice. Develop musicality, timing, and clear sounds with progressive footwork and rhythm
